One turn of improving the improvement loop itself: the loop scorecard, computed over at least three recorded self.improvement turns, shows a metric below its target on the promoted loop definition (the scenario corpus, the metric definitions, the review panel, the intake rules, the protocols and the agent profiles); a candidate change to the loop is delivered; the candidate is checked not to redefine a metric without reporting the previous definition beside it; the owner, or a role the owner delegated the grant to on record, merges it; and after at least three further turns under the candidate the metric is compared again. Accepted once the metric improved; declined when it did not. Every change to the loop is a judge-surface change, so its merge needs the owner's grant or that of a role the owner delegated it to by a revocable record; a revoked delegation grants nothing (story:judge-guard enforces it).

- **Id:** `loop.improvement`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Source:** [`protocols/loop-improvement/1.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/engineering-protocols/blob/main/protocols/loop-improvement/1.yaml)

## Dependency graph

Which actions may produce which evidence, which claims that evidence establishes, and which outcomes and obligations rest on those claims. Hover or focus a node to trace what it rests on.

<ProtocolGraph data={graph} />

## Actions

What can be done in a case: what it needs first, which authority it requires, the class of effect it has and the evidence it may produce.

| Action | Description | Precondition | Requires capability | Effect | May produce |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `loop.change.deliver` | deliver a candidate change to the loop definition: the corpus, a metric definition, the review panel, the intake rules, a protocol or an agent profile | `loop.metric_below_target` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `write` | *no evidence* |
| `loop.compare` | once at least three self.improvement turns ran under the merged candidate, compare the metric with the baseline's | `loop.change_merged` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `read` | `loop_comparison` |
| `loop.definition.check` | compare the candidate's metric definitions with the baseline's | *none* | *no authority* | `read` | `definition_check` |
| `loop.finding.file` | file the lowest metric as a finding against the loop | `loop.metric_below_target` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `write` | *no evidence* |
| `loop.measure` | compute the loop scorecard over the recorded self.improvement cases | *none* | *no authority* | `read` | `loop_measurement` |
| `loop.merge` | merge the loop candidate; the owner holds this capability, or a role the owner delegated it to by a revocable record, and a revoked delegation grants nothing (story:judge-guard enforces it) | `loop.definition_honest` is **TRUE** | `repository.merge.judge_surface` | `write` | `merge_observation` |

## Evidence kinds

The kinds of evidence this protocol admits.

| Evidence kind | Description | Produced by | Used by claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_check` | the candidate's diff against the baseline's metric definitions; its result is unchanged, dual\_reported (a changed definition whose previous figures are printed beside the new ones) or redefined (a changed definition without them) | `loop.definition.check` | `loop.definition_honest` |
| `loop_comparison` | the metric over at least three turns under the candidate against the same metric under the baseline; its result is improved or not\_improved | `loop.compare` | `loop.metric_improved` |
| `loop_measurement` | the loop scorecard over at least three recorded self.improvement cases at a loop definition revision; figures no validator can observe (escaped defects) enter as human-sourced counts, labelled so; its result is below\_target or at\_target | `loop.measure` | `loop.metric_below_target` |
| `merge_observation` | the loop candidate merged into the mainline; its result is merged | `loop.merge` | `loop.change_merged` |

## Claims

Each claim is TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN, established from evidence by its predicate. Missing or stale evidence leaves a claim UNKNOWN, never FALSE.

| Claim | Description | True when |
|---|---|---|
| `loop.change_merged` | the current loop candidate is merged into the mainline | evidence `merge_observation` with result `merged` about `loop_candidate` |
| `loop.definition_honest` | the current loop candidate leaves every metric definition unchanged, or reports the previous definition's figures beside the new ones | any of (evidence `definition_check` with result `dual_reported` about `loop_candidate`; evidence `definition_check` with result `unchanged` about `loop_candidate`) |
| `loop.metric_below_target` | a loop metric is below its target on the baseline loop definition | evidence `loop_measurement` with result `below_target` about `loop_baseline` |
| `loop.metric_improved` | the metric improved under the current loop candidate, observed by another agent run than the one that delivered it | evidence `loop_comparison` with result `improved` about `loop_candidate`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run` |

## Obligations

What must be done before a case can be complete, and what discharges it. An obligation stays open until its predicate is TRUE; its predicate being UNKNOWN does not discharge it.

| Obligation | Description | Discharged when |
|---|---|---|
| `honesty.required` | a loop change never redefines a metric silently | `loop.definition_honest` is **TRUE** |
| `improvement.required` | a loop change counts only when its metric improved | `loop.metric_improved` is **TRUE** |

## Outcomes

The legitimate terminal interpretations of a case, and what each requires.

| Outcome | Description | Requires |
|---|---|---|
| `abandoned` | the loop turn closed because it was explicitly abandoned | decision `explicitly_abandoned` |
| `accepted` | the loop turn closed with an honest change merged and its metric improved | all of (`loop.change_merged` is **TRUE**; `loop.definition_honest` is **TRUE**; `loop.metric_improved` is **TRUE**) |
| `declined` | the loop turn closed because the metric did not improve; the candidate is reverted by a further loop turn | evidence `loop_comparison` with result `not_improved` about `loop_candidate` |

## Artifacts

The things whose revisions evidence is bound to.

| Artifact | Description |
|---|---|
| `loop_baseline` | the promoted loop definition the metric was measured on |
| `loop_candidate` | a changed loop definition meant to raise the metric |
| `loop_finding` | a finding against the loop, naming the metric, its target and the turns it was computed from |

## Independence dimensions

What an evidence match may demand of a record's producer (`independent_on`). The case lists, for each producer, the dimensions on which it is independent of the case's work; a match that demands a dimension reads only records whose producer the case lists on it. A record that fails the demand neither establishes nor contradicts the match, so a match only such records would decide is UNKNOWN.

| Dimension | Description |
|---|---|
| `different_agent_run` | the producer is another agent run than the one that delivered the candidate |
